newsitem.title: USA: NICOR says Q1 not indicative of full year.
newsitem.headline: NICOR says Q1 not indicative of full year.

text.p: NICOR Inc said Tuesday the decline in its first-quarter net income had been expected and the results are "not indicative" of its expectations for the full year.

The natural gas utility and containerized shipping concern said first quarter net was $40.4 million, down from $45.5 million a year ago. "The decrease was primarily due to lower results at Northern Illinois Gas," the company's principal business unit, NICOR said.

Gas distribution income fell to $68.3 million from $75.9 million, "due mainly to the impact of rate design changes resulting from last year's rate order and the impact of weather that was warmer than the prior year," NICOR said.
